module: Manages the list of control hints shown by the missionControls interface app during a mission. Each hint is identified by a category, which makes it possible to add or remove one without touching the others (for example from a flowgraph node). The list sorted by order is sent to the interface via the SetMissionControls event.
notes: The default category is args.category, otherwise args.action, otherwise args.uiEvent; with none of the three, setControl does nothing.
In setControls, if the hint has no category, action or uiEvent, the index in the list is used as the key; order defaults to the index.
The extension stays loaded permanently (manual unload).

setControl.desc: Adds, updates or removes (clear=true) a hint, then sends the whole list back to the interface.

args.desc: {category|action|uiEvent, action=string|nil, uiEvent=string|nil, label=string|nil, order=number|nil (0 by default), clear=boolean|nil}.

setControls.desc: Replaces all hints with the supplied list, then sends it to the interface.

list.desc: Hints in the same format as setControl.

clearControls.desc: Removes all hints and sends SetMissionControlsResetAll to the interface.

sendAllData.desc: Sends the current list back to the interface (useful when the app mounts).

onInit.desc: Initialization hook: sets the extension to manual unload.
